scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:tui
scripts.security:deps: npm run security:supply-chain && npm run security:signatures && npm run security:audit
scripts.ci: npm run verify:kimi-runtime-qualifications && npm run verify:cursor-runtime-qualifications && npm run verify:tui-runtime-policy && npm run security:deps && npm run lint:errors && npm run typecheck && npm run guard:architecture && npm run guard:provider-intent && npm run guard:doctrine-integrity && npm run guard:third-party-notices && npm run guard:ios-plist && npm run guard:platform-path-literals && npm run guard:platform-portability && npm run guard:platform-evidence && npm run guard:control-bytes && npm run test && npm run test:precommit-hook && npm run guard:no-bundled-secrets && npm run smoke:node-pty && npm run format:ratchet
scripts.build: npm run verify:kimi-runtime-qualifications && npm run verify:cursor-runtime-qualifications && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && npm run tui:build
scripts.build:unpack: npm run clean:dist && TASKWRAITH_BRIDGE_ARCH=universal npm run prebuild:bridge-daemon && node scripts/smoke-bridge-daemon-roundtrip.cjs && npm run prepare:mac-universal-deps && npm run prepare:tui-runtime:mac && npm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --mac --universal --dir -c.npmRebuild=false && node scripts/smoke-packaged-electron.cjs dist
scripts.build:debug:mac: npm run prebuild:bridge-daemon && npm run prepare:tui-runtime && TASKWRAITH_DEBUG_BUILD=1 npm run build && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.debug.yml && node scripts/smoke-packaged-electron.cjs dist-debug
scripts.build:debug:mac:notarized: npm run prebuild:bridge-daemon && npm run prepare:tui-runtime && TASKWRAITH_DEBUG_BUILD=1 npm run build && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.debug.yml -c.mac.notarize=true && node scripts/smoke-packaged-electron.cjs dist-debug
scripts.build:debug:win: npm run prepare:tui-runtime && TASKWRAITH_DEBUG_BUILD=1 npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --config electron-builder.debug.yml && node scripts/smoke-packaged-electron.cjs dist-debug
scripts.build:win:unpack: npm run clean:dist && npm run prepare:tui-runtime:win && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --arm64 --dir && node scripts/smoke-packaged-electron.cjs dist/win-unpacked && node scripts/smoke-packaged-electron.cjs dist/win-arm64-unpacked
scripts.build:win:compile: npm run clean:dist && npm run prepare:tui-runtime:win && npm run build
scripts.build:win:checks: node scripts/write-win-update-feeds.cjs dist && node scripts/smoke-packaged-electron.cjs dist/win-unpacked && node scripts/smoke-packaged-electron.cjs dist/win-arm64-unpacked && npm run validate:win-update-feed
scripts.build:win: npm run build:win:compile && electron-builder --win --x64 --arm64 --publish never && npm run build:win:checks
scripts.build:win:nopublish: npm run build:win:compile && electron-builder --win --x64 --arm64 --publish never && npm run build:win:checks
scripts.build:mac: npm run clean:dist && npm run test:swift:bridge && TASKWRAITH_BRIDGE_ARCH=universal npm run prebuild:bridge-daemon && node scripts/smoke-bridge-daemon-roundtrip.cjs && npm run prepare:mac-universal-deps && npm run prepare:tui-runtime:mac && npm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --mac --universal --publish never -c.npmRebuild=false && npm run finalize:mac-release-artifacts:unsigned && npm run validate:mac-update-feed
scripts.build:mac:notarized: npm run prerelease:verify && npm run clean:dist && npm run test:swift:bridge && TASKWRAITH_BRIDGE_ARCH=universal npm run prebuild:bridge-daemon && node scripts/smoke-bridge-daemon-roundtrip.cjs && npm run prepare:mac-universal-deps && npm run prepare:tui-runtime:mac && npm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --mac --universal --publish never -c.npmRebuild=false -c.mac.notarize=true && npm run finalize:mac-release-artifacts && node scripts/smoke-packaged-electron.cjs dist && npm run smoke:mac-artifacts && npm run validate:mac-update-feed && npm run security:sbom
scripts.build:linux:compile: npm run clean:dist && npm run prepare:tui-runtime && npm run build
scripts.build:linux:checks: node scripts/smoke-packaged-electron.cjs dist/linux-unpacked && npm run smoke:linux-artifacts && npm run validate:linux-update-feed && node scripts/guard-no-bundled-secrets.cjs --require-packaged
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:linux:compile && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --publish never && npm run build:linux:checks
scripts.build:linux:nopublish: npm run build:linux:compile && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --publish never && npm run build:linux:checks
